description: Decal actor catalog: decal IDs name a Blueprint decal actor, and a residency flag controls which decals are preloaded at boot.

ID.technical: FName row key looked up over DecalDataTables (+0x800) with FindRow<T> or the shared Status_FindDecalRow (0x141048AF0); NAME_None is rejected. Requesters include animation notifies (UGameAnimNotify_Decal.Id_Decal), effect rows, destructible reactioner SpawnDecalId and sequencer section DecalId. 51 exported rows.

Filename.technical: Serialized C++ property FName FileName. AGameRenderManager::SpawnDecal(row) passes it to SpawnDecal(FileName,...), which builds PrimaryAssetId(GamePrimaryAssetType_Decal, FileName), loads a UClass, spawns an AGameDecalActor deferred, attaches it to the render manager, assigns sort order and FinishSpawning at the requested transform. At boot, resident rows' names are turned into Decal primary-asset loaders. Export rows use <ID>_BP, although some cross-table rows reference asset names that differ from their own ID family.

bResident.simple: Whether the decal Blueprint is preloaded at boot.
bResident.technical: Bool; boot collects every FGameDataTableRow_Decal row (0x13c8420) and AGameRenderManager::BootInitialize creates Decal-type FGamePrimaryAssetLoaders only for rows with bResident=true. Non-resident decal assets are loaded on demand when their row is requested. Constructor default false. Three of the 51 exported rows are resident: DCL_01100, DCL_01200, DCL_80311.

notes: DecalDataTables is at +0x800 in AGameDataTableManager; the name 'DecalDataTable' is both a DataTable primary asset and the loader name. CharacterDecalDataTable (+0x500) and MapDecalDataTable (+0x3C0) are distinct tables that reference these IDs/filenames elsewhere.
The export key is 'Filename' while the C++ UPROPERTY is 'FileName'; they are the same field (case-insensitive generator match).

Spawning supports type 0 ('Decal', managed by the render manager for gameplay/animation/sequencer requests) and type 1 ('DestructibleDecal', used by UGameDestructibleReactioner::SpawnBreakDecal). DecalType is a caller-supplied argument, not a data-table field; Scale/socket/rotation parameters likewise come from callers.
No additional fields exist in the reconstructed row struct or the 51 exported rows.

usages.detail: Boot collects all decal rows from the manager (retail 0x13c8420) and passes them to the render manager's BootInitialize.
BootInitialize filters bResident rows and creates persistent Decal asset loaders for their FileName assets.
Animation notifies resolve Id_Decal, compute a transform from the mesh bone/owner and spawn the decal through the render manager (retail 0x14101C870).
Breakable objects resolve SpawnDecalId and spawn a type-1 DestructibleDecal with optional swizzled SpawnDecalSize (retail 0x135c800).
Sequencer spawn-decal track resolves Section.DecalId once per setup and spawns at the bound decal actor's transform.
SpawnDecal resolves the row's FileName to a primary asset class and manages the spawned actor's lifetime, attachment and sort order.
